probe_scope: original training-side receiver probes, disjoint from semantic scoring, not independent of SGD
checkpoint_retention: one rolling complete recovery state; no test-selected best model
evaluation: unchanged official Full test once every round; scores never use it
control_scope: read-only same-input snapshots, no additional trained comparator
figure_purpose: document actual mechanism operation, not infer utility or performance advantage
illustrative_case_rule: first actually active round in each fixed stage; smallest all-profile shared region; never select by U magnitude, Accuracy or CE utility
record_selection: all1000 rounds retained, including neutral and missing evidence
